result.summary:
Scope test: this diff adds test-support code (test/support/tenant_schema_reaper.ex, test/test_helper.exs, test/support/service_catalog_reaper_test.exs) that resolves no secret, and touches a lookup/DELETE against a table (service_catalog) -- treated as in-scope per this run's own instructions even though the table is a deliberately global, non-tenant-scoped table (per lib/letflow/service_catalog.ex's own moduledoc and prior REVIEWER sign-off, 2026-08-30) and no lib/letflow/ file or migration changed in this diff.

INV-1 (tenant data isolation) -- NOT-APPLICABLE. No new/changed Ecto schema module or migration in this diff (git diff --name-only confirms zero priv/repo/migrations/*.exs and zero lib/letflow/*.ex files -- the only lib/ hit is the markdown design doc). service_catalog itself is confirmed (lib/letflow/service_catalog.ex lines 28-53, REVIEWER-signed 2026-08-30) to be deliberately global -- no :prefix, no tenant_id column, not in Letflow.TenantProvisioning.tenant_scoped_migrations/0 -- so INV-1's :prefix-scoping requirement does not apply to this table at all, and this diff doesn't touch that established design.

INV-2, INV-3, INV-5 -- NOT-APPLICABLE (S4/S5 not started).

INV-4 (secrets by reference only) -- APPLIES, PASS. Read lib/letflow/service_catalog/entry.ex's full schema (lines 53-70): endpoint_url, request_schema, response_schema, required_auth (Ecto.Enum descriptor, not key material), timeout_ms, retry_policy, scope, owner_tenant_id, created_at/updated_at -- no column holds actual secret/credential material. The new :warning log (tenant_schema_reaper.ex line ~253) names only service_id and scope per found row; confirmed by reading the schema these can never carry a secret value by construction.

INV-6 -- read as advisory for new data-access paths; this is a test-support sweep of an already-reviewed global table, not a new access path into tenant data; no separate scoping demonstration required beyond INV-1's NOT-APPLICABLE finding above.

INV-7 (no SQL string interpolation) -- APPLIES, PASS. `grep -n "query!(" test/support/tenant_schema_reaper.ex` shows the two new call sites (`repo.query!("SELECT service_id, scope FROM service_catalog")` and `repo.query!("DELETE FROM service_catalog")`) are both static string literals with zero interpolation of any tenant- or user-controlled value into the SQL text -- confirmed by reading the actual diff hunk, not just the design doc's description. (The log-message string interpolation a few lines away is Logger output, not SQL, and carries only service_id/scope per INV-4 above.)

INV-8 (no unhandled crashes) -- APPLIES, PASS. Read the full try/rescue/after block (tenant_schema_reaper.ex lines 224-268): the rescue clause wraps the entire body (Sandbox.mode(:auto), current_application_name/1, concurrent_invocation_present?/2, both query!/1 calls) and returns {:ok, %{deleted: 0}} on any exception, logged at :error -- identical shape/parity to the pre-existing sweep_orphans/2 contract. Verified for real, not just read: ran `mix test test/support/service_catalog_reaper_test.exs test/support/tenant_schema_reaper_test.exs --seed 0` -- Result: 11 passed, including the deliberate BrokenRepo failure-mode test, whose forced exception is visible in the real log output ('[error] TenantSchemaReaper.sweep_service_catalog_orphans/1 aborted: ** (RuntimeError) boom (BrokenRepo.query!/1, forced for ISS-0414 test)') immediately followed by the test's own passing assertion of {:ok, %{deleted: 0}} -- the never-raises claim is real, not asserted-only. Also ran `MIX_ENV=test mix compile --warnings-as-errors` (clean) and `mix format --check-formatted` (clean).

MIX_ENV=test confinement (task item 1): traced mix.exs -- elixirc_paths(:test) is the only env compiling test/support (elixirc_paths(_) => ["lib"] otherwise), so tenant_schema_reaper.ex cannot even be loaded outside MIX_ENV=test. test/test_helper.exs is loaded exclusively by ExUnit.start(), which only ever runs from the `mix test` task -- Mix's own `test` task hardcodes MIX_ENV to test before any config or code loads, regardless of an ambient MIX_ENV value, and config/test.exs (the only config sourced under that env) points Letflow.Repo at `letflow_test#{MIX_TEST_PARTITION}` (config/test.exs line 54), never a dev/prod database name. No invocation shape in this repo (plain `mix test`, `mix test <path>`, scripts/test_parallel.sh, `mix letflow.check.test`) bypasses this. Confirmed structurally, not by convention alone.

Concurrent-invocation guard re-verification (task item 2): read concurrent_invocation_present?/2, current_application_name/1, group_tag_of/1 in full (tenant_schema_reaper.ex lines 280-320) -- byte-for-byte unchanged by this diff (confirmed: git diff shows zero hunks touching these lines), reused verbatim as the design claims, not duplicated. Traced config/test.exs lines 71-95 (ISS-0110/ISS-0217 tagging) and scripts/test_parallel.sh: each test_parallel.sh partition connects to its OWN database (`letflow_test#{MIX_TEST_PARTITION}`, a distinct partition index per launched process) even though all partitions are visible to each other in the single server-wide pg_stat_activity view -- so the TEST_PARALLEL_GROUP-tag exclusion correctly lets sibling partitions proceed with their sweep without deferring, and because each sibling's service_catalog rows live in a physically different database, a sibling's DELETE FROM service_catalog can only ever affect that sibling's own partition database, never cross-contaminate another partition's data, even in the hypothetical worst case. A genuinely separate, non-sibling invocation (no matching group tag, e.g. two ungrouped `mix test` runs sharing the default `letflow_test` database) is correctly NOT excluded and still defers, exactly as ISS-0110 requires. This guard was already load-bearing for sweep_orphans/2 and is unmodified here; new coverage in service_catalog_reaper_test.exs's own criterion-3/4 tests exercises both branches directly against sweep_service_catalog_orphans/1 specifically, and both passed in the real test run above.

Scope (task item 5): `git diff origin/main...HEAD --name-only` confirms only test/support/tenant_schema_reaper.ex, test/test_helper.exs, test/support/service_catalog_reaper_test.exs (new), docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md, lib/letflow/design/iss0414-service-catalog-safety-net.md (design doc, not code), and handoff/registry bookkeeping files changed. Zero files under lib/letflow/*.ex or priv/repo/migrations/*.exs. No production code touched.

No defect found. All applicable invariants PASS.
